comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito, @maxiloc and @Jerskouille to be potential reviewers

One drawback to this approach is that the url is updated after you stop typing. That's the goal of the PR but it can be disturbing if it takes too long and "too long" is user dependent. cc @bobylito 

Still, the refactor around search-box is valid and I will extract it and submit a PR

Then we need to really find out what's wrong with updating the url at every keystroke and find ways to do it more efficiently and less often. Maybe by debouncing the replace state itself, with a low debounce value.
Not quite good/ready yet. Refactor still legit and moved

title: fix(searchBox): stop updating at every keystroke
